name: Aimer Co., Ltd.
summary: Aimer Co., Ltd. specializes in the complete process of bringing personal garments and related products to market, from initial research and development through manufacturing and sales. The company offers a comprehensive range of items, including intimate apparel like bras and underwear, various types of clothing such as loungewear, activewear, thermal wear, and swimwear, as well as hosiery. Beyond clothing, their product line extends to home textiles, decorative accessories for the home, and protective masks. This Beijing, China-based enterprise was established on October 13, 1981.
